_note: Israel, Gaza and antisemitism claims from July 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says a Gaza agreement he was shown on 9 January arrives as predicted, with a disarmament deal reached and building work to follow.
mentions.quote: I saw that on January the 9th... and the Lord said this was coming
mentions.falsify_match: A Gaza disarmament agreement and reconstruction programme in 2026.

mentions.claim_text: Antisemitism reaches an all-time high in the days ahead, at a level not seen before.
mentions.quote: anti-semitism is going to be at an all-time high in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Recorded antisemitic incidents reach record levels.
mentions.falsify_miss: Incident counts stay below prior peaks.

mentions.claim_text: War spreads with Poland involved, an entity out of the pit influencing Putin, and a two-state solution being attempted, which he ties back to the fig tree and Israel.
mentions.quote: Watch a two-state solution try to come forth
mentions.falsify_match: Poland drawn into the war and a formal two-state push.

mentions.claim_text: He draws a pattern between US pressure on Israeli land and disasters at home, citing 2005 as the precedent and asking whether the current administration has repeated it.
mentions.quote: Did Trump just do a George Bush Jr.
mentions.falsify_match: A major US disaster shortly after a US-backed division of Israeli land.
mentions.falsify_miss: No disaster follows such a move.
